baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction joins وجوه at word 1, the outward fronts that meet an observer, to مسفرة at word 3, an adjective of clearing and bright disclosure.
baseline_models.mechanism: An obscuring layer recedes from the outward front, so the newly exposed surface presents daylight-like clarity.

activation_trace.role: The face/front supplies the visible surface that meets an observer.
Uncovering and clearing supply removal of the layer that had hidden the surface.
Daybreak and bright disclosure supply the quality of the revealed surface.

changed_reading.after: Some outward selves have been cleared of obstruction and appear with the clarity of daybreak.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وجوه can mark orientation and face-to-face encounter, while مسفرة can mark clearing into visibility.
baseline_models.mechanism: The face is relational rather than merely chromatic: an orientation becomes open enough for direct encounter, with no screen between parties.

activation_trace.role: Orientation and direction turn the face into a vector toward an encounter.
Facing and confrontation supply the direct relation established by that vector.
Clearing removes what would prevent the face-to-face relation.

changed_reading.before: Brightness is a property located on a complexion.
changed_reading.after: Brightness is the openness of an orientation: these faces can meet what is before them directly.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The plural وجوه stands beside يومئذ, and its branch field includes the forepart of a day; مسفرة supplies daybreak.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two focus roots superimpose a temporal image on human faces: a forepart advances and darkness gives way, making the faces carriers of that day's new visible phase.

activation_trace.role: The forepart or beginning of a day lets faces function as leading temporal fronts.
Daybreak supplies the transition by which those fronts become visible.

changed_reading.before: The day is only a timestamp for shining faces.
changed_reading.after: The faces are not only lit on that day; they figure its advancing, dawn-like forefront.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وجوه can stand for the selves, and the branch field of مسفرة includes writing and books as disclosure.
baseline_models.mechanism: The outward self behaves like an opened written surface: what belongs to the person is no longer sealed but becomes legible on the face.

activation_trace.role: The face standing for the self supplies the personal content that becomes public.
Writing and books as disclosure supply legibility rather than light alone.

changed_reading.before: The face displays a pleasant visual state.
changed_reading.after: The face is an opened record on which the self has become readable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening gives inverse facial kinetics: a face contracts and the person turns away. Against that pair, the focus clearing is not generic luminosity but release from contraction and aversion into direct presence.

activation_trace.role: Face-to-face encounter supplies the relational state reached in the focus.
Clearing supplies the opening that reverses closure.
Facial contraction from distress supplies the initial closed surface.
Turning away supplies the relational withdrawal paired with contraction.

structural_cues: The first ayah couples a facial alteration with bodily withdrawal; the focus later couples faces with disclosure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies contraction, aversion, and later cleared faces; I infer a reversal from closed relation to open encounter. A live alternative is that the opening scene and final face groups are only distant contrasts, not one arc.

changed_reading.before: The faces simply acquire more light.
changed_reading.after: The faces are released from the surah's opening contraction and aversion, becoming openly present to encounter.

context_deltas.mechanism: Blindness near the opening and directed looking later separate being visible from possessing sight. The focus can therefore describe selves made manifest to encounter, without making visual ability the measure of their clarity.

activation_trace.role: The outward front supplies what is presented, whether or not every participant sees it.
Uncovering supplies objective manifestation rather than an observer's visual capacity.
Loss of sight supplies the distinction between visibility and the ability to see.
Directed sight or insight supplies the deliberate act of attending to what is shown.

structural_cues: A blind visitor stands near the opening, while a later imperative explicitly redirects human looking before the final face scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies impaired sight, commanded looking, and uncovered faces; I infer that disclosure belongs to the shown self rather than to visual privilege. Alternatively, the blindness and looking cues may not modify مسفرة at all.

changed_reading.before: Bright faces chiefly reward or address sight.
changed_reading.after: The selves are manifest in themselves; seeing is a separate ethical act, not the condition that makes them clear.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence of written sheets and safarah activates the documentary branch already latent in مسفرة. A face can now operate as a public record: the self appears on an opened surface rather than merely glowing.

activation_trace.role: The face standing for the self supplies what the record discloses.
Book and writing as disclosure make the focus adjective capable of documentary legibility.
The written sheet supplies an explicit inscribed surface in the context.
The repeated root beside the sheets carries the book-discloses-writing image into the context.

structural_cues: Ayat 80:11-16 move from reminder to honored sheets and their handlers before the same root reappears in the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sheets, safarah, and the root's writing-disclosure branch; I assign the face the role of readable surface. The live alternative is a lexical pivot between scribes and brightness with no transfer of record imagery.

changed_reading.before: The face's state is visible but carries no readable content.
changed_reading.after: The outward self reads like an opened sheet: its state and history have become publicly legible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Direction in وجوه and journeying in سفر join the extended path that is opened after difficulty. The focus can register arrival or successful passage in the travelers' forward-facing orientation.

activation_trace.role: Orientation supplies a destination-facing vector.
Journeying supplies passage across distance rather than brightness alone.
The extended traversable road supplies the route of the passage.
Opening into ease after difficulty supplies the route's enabled movement.

structural_cues: The made-easy path precedes death, burial, and renewed emergence, giving the path a whole-life horizon.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an opened path plus focus branches of orientation and travel; I infer that the visible face bears arrival. The alternative is that سبيل describes only life's provisioned route and the travel branch is inactive in مسفرة.

changed_reading.before: The faces are stationary surfaces illuminated at the scene.
changed_reading.after: The faces are forward fronts of passage, openly bearing that an enabled route has reached its destination.

context_deltas.mechanism: Burial hides, renewed life opens and spreads, earth splits, and growth rises through the opening. This material sequence recasts إسفار as resurfacing: the face becomes the first exposed front of a self brought out of concealment.

activation_trace.role: The front supplies the first surface to emerge into encounter.
Removal of covering supplies the transition from interment to exposure.
Interment supplies the hidden state from which a front can resurface.
Reviving the dead supplies the personal transition out of the hidden state.
Splitting and opening supply the material aperture through which emergence occurs.
Growth out of earth supplies a visible analogue for resurfacing.

structural_cues: The sequence first states death, burial, and revival, then repeats concealment-to-emergence through split earth and growth.
The branchless root ص خ خ at 80:33 structurally marks the abrupt threshold into the final scene and is not used as branch evidence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies burial, revival, split earth, and growth; I transfer their emergence pattern to the clearing of the face. The alternative is that the agricultural sequence explains provision only and does not model bodily disclosure.

changed_reading.after: Visibility itself is the event: faces surface as the first cleared fronts of selves brought out from concealment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Kinship and companionship fall away as each person is occupied by an individually sufficient affair. The plural faces then present discrete selves with no relative acting as shield, proxy, or social frame.

activation_trace.role: The face standing for the self supplies the exposed individual unit.
Uncovering supplies the removal of social shelter around that self.
Flight supplies the active severing of relational proximity.
The individual person supplies the unit left after relations recede.
Each person's own affair supplies the individualized burden or condition.
Sufficiency supplies the affair's capacity to occupy each person without recourse to kin.

structural_cues: The kin-by-kin flight and the distributive 'each person' immediately precede the indefinite plural 'faces.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies relational flight and individually sufficient affairs; I treat relations as social coverings whose loss leaves the self directly presented. Alternatively, the flight only sets urgency and does not define the ontology of the faces.

changed_reading.before: The verse paints one bright sector of a crowd.
changed_reading.after: It presents exposed, irreducibly individual selves, each publicly carried by its own face after social proxies have fallen away.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following adjectives give the bright face physical and affective motion: it expands, shows, and is opened at the skin by welcome news. Radiance becomes an embodied disclosure in which inward joy reaches the outward surface.

activation_trace.role: The visible face/front supplies the surface on which the motion appears.
Bright disclosure supplies the initial visible state.
Expansion of the face and appearance of teeth supply bodily opening rather than abstract light.
News that opens the skin with joy supplies an incoming cause for the outward disclosure.
Wholeness joining outward and inward supplies alignment between visible face and inner state.

structural_cues: Ayah 80:39 continues the same nominal portrait with two more feminine singular adjectives.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies facial expansion, joyful news, and outward-inward wholeness; I infer that these explain how the prior clearing is embodied. A live alternative is that all three adjectives are parallel results with no causal order.

changed_reading.before: Musfirah names a static brightness already on the face.
changed_reading.after: The face opens under received joy until inward gladness becomes bodily and publicly visible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next face group is acted upon by layers: dust lies on the face and a constricting darkness overtakes it. The focus group's إسفار is therefore best heard as the opposite surface process, a clearing from overlay rather than an immutable essence or skin color.

activation_trace.role: The outward front supplies the common surface on which either clearing or coating occurs.
Clearing a cover supplies the focus group's surface process.
The repeated face/front establishes the same kind of surface for the contrasting group.
Dust and earth-color supply a deposited coating on that surface.
Overtaking and overpowering supply the direction by which the coating comes upon the face.
Constriction and reduction supply the narrowing effect of the dark overlay.

structural_cues: The text repeats 'faces that day' and then explicitly places something 'upon them,' creating a controlled surface contrast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies matched face constructions, clearing, dust, and an overtaking constriction; I infer inverse surface processes. The alternative is that the pair only contrasts emotions or outcomes, without foregrounding material overlay.

changed_reading.before: One class has an intrinsically bright facial essence and another an intrinsically dark one.
changed_reading.after: Both are exposed fronts under processes: one has been cleared into openness, while the other is overtaken and coated.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the envoy/mediator branch of سفر inside an adjective normally carried by brightness. It remains anchored through the face as a site of direct encounter and through the same root at 80:15; render it only as a secondary communicative affordance, not as a claim that the faces are literally envoys.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: وجوه supplies encounter and مسفرة carries a branch in which a mediator removes estrangement.

activation_trace.role: Face-to-face meeting supplies the two-sided social relation.
The mediator who removes estrangement lets the disclosed face do relational work.
The earlier safarah occurrence keeps the envoy/mediation image locally active.

changed_reading.before: The face passively receives or reflects light.
changed_reading.after: The open face also mediates the hidden self into encounter, removing estrangement by making it communicable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The cross-domain move from irrigated earth to facial brightness is materially odd, but the water inventory explicitly includes luster in the face and the focus explicitly names a face becoming bright. Carry it as a tactile analogue for reflective vitality, qualified as an activation rather than a lexical substitution for مسفرة.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The face/front is the surface, and bright disclosure is the visible effect to be materially specified.

activation_trace.role: The face/front supplies the surface capable of carrying sheen.
Bright disclosure supplies the visible luster requiring a material analogue.
Pouring supplies the movement by which water reaches and changes a surface.
Water-like luster in a face directly supplies reflective vitality rather than emitted light.

changed_reading.before: The faces emit an abstract, immaterial brightness.
changed_reading.after: Their clearing may be imagined as a watered surface coming alive with reflective luster.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the condemned final label activates both dawn-breaking and cover-rupturing branches near the focus's own daybreak/uncovering field. It remains valid as a contrast within packet-provided branch images, but downstream prose must not equate the two groups or transfer positive value to فجور; it should state only that exposure can be clear opening or transgressive breach.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: مسفرة is anchored in uncovering and daybreak, so nearby branches that also break a cover test whether visibility alone carries the value.

activation_trace.role: Uncovering supplies a clear removal of obstruction in the focus.
Daybreak supplies the focus's constructive transition from darkness to clarity.
Covering supplies the neighboring posture of concealment.
Dawn breaking from night creates a formal echo of the focus's daybreak image.
Deviation and tearing a cover distinguish violent breach from lucid clearing.

changed_reading.before: Any movement from covering into visibility is inherently the same positive disclosure.
changed_reading.after: The focus presents lucid clearing, while the nearby branch field preserves a rival mode of exposure as rupture; the quality of opening, not visibility alone, matters.

strongest_changes: The opening contracted and averted face turns the focus into a relational reversal: clearing means open presence, not color alone.
Burial, revival, split earth, and growth make the bright face the first resurfaced front of a self emerging from concealment.
The repeated contrasting faces under dust and constriction make brightness a cleared surface condition rather than a fixed essence.
Sheets and safarah keep a live documentary reading in which the face becomes an opened, publicly legible record.
summary.what_was_special: Two compact focus roots generated coexisting visual, relational, temporal, documentary, itinerant, material, and social mechanisms. The most productive latent axis was not simply light versus dark but modes of surface change: contraction, covering, clearing, opening, emergence, coating, and rupture.
remaining_uncertainties: The temporal-forefront, journey, mediation, and ruptured-dawn readings are branch-supported but form-distant and should remain explicitly exploratory.
The record model may be a genuine same-root activation from 80:13-15 or only a deliberate lexical pivot from safarah to brightness.
The emergence and watered-luster models depend on transferring material sequences to faces; the packet supplies the materials but the analogical arrows are reader-supplied.
The exact relation among مسفرة, ضاحكة, and مستبشرة can remain causal, sequential, or simply coordinative.
